m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: I hope you thought to bring the books back. I can hardly remember where I left them!
You know, it occurs to me that as a visiting student, you haven't received any instruction in the history of this school.
Rather than chew your ear with a boring lecture, I recommend seeking out part of the four-book series: The Pigswick Papers!
This fine set of volumes will illuminate the darkness, stoke the imagination, and set you on a path of higher learning.
Inconveniently, these works are spread throughout Wysteria, so you will have to keep your eyes open for them.
Seek out the four-volume Pigswick Papers, books to teach you about Pigswick. They are scattered throughout Wysteria.
